name: MSE-5
description: The MSE-5 was an experimental model of general, multi-purpose droid manufactured as part of the MSE series by Rebaxan Columni, a company based on the Chadra-Fan homeworld of Chad. Both the MSE-5 and the also experimental MSE-4 were inspired by the chak-chak, a small, six-limbed rodent native to Chad.
